english.title: Agitators
english.objective: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
english.complete: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.
english.detail:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, <class>?

english.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud
english.objective: Slay 10 Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh.
english.progress: How'd it go? Did ye give 'em what-for?
english.complete:
These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs.

Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.
english.detail:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.

english.title: Secure the Mountain
english.objective: Find Mountaineer Cornelius in the Grizzled Den for Mountaineer Gretchen.
english.progress: Any news? I told Cornelius not tae go into the Grizzled Den alone, but he's always been a stubborn sort.
english.complete:
Ach, the fool...

Thank ye for the help, <name>. Guess we have our report.
english.detail:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.

english.title: Rime's Wrath
english.complete: I wish we could have simply placated them. Unfortunately it was beyond my knowledge and they were too dangerous to leave unchecked.
english.detail:
You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.

These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.

english.title: Sparring Match
english.objective: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.
english.progress: There is no teacher quite like the sharp end of your adversary pointed at your heart.
english.complete:
You honor me with your abilities, <class>. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.

Take these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.
english.detail:
Hail, young <class>. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
